billingConfig.title: Billing Config
billingConfig.deptPhysicianDesc: Master data for all hospitals; reconciliation sheetName maps to department

customerForm.billingEnabledHint: When off, customer product rules are not merged at reconciliation
customerForm.billingDisabledConfigHint: Turn on to configure billing policies, dept/physician, export templates, pricing mode, and product rules.
customerForm.globalDiscountExistsWarning: A global discount (All/ANY) already exists. Remove the existing global discount rule before adding another.
customerForm.logisticsFeePerTripPlaceholder: Leave empty to use global rule
customerForm.logisticsFeePerTripHint: Overrides global logistics unit price (per trip)
customerForm.billingPricingModeHint: Controls whether unmatched rows fall back to the hospital HT/LT tier pricing table.
customerForm.billingPricingModeStandardDesc: Customer special rules first; otherwise hospital HT/LT tier pricing and dressing rules apply.
customerForm.billingPricingModeSpecialOnlyDesc: Only customer special rules, dressing rules, and path overrides; no HT/LT tiers when unmatched (manual review).
customerForm.billingPricingModeHybridDesc: Same as standard: special rules first, then tier pricing when unmatched; use Standard pricing override below to replace the default HT/LT/dressing tables.
customerForm.standardPricingOverrideDesc: Overrides the default high/low temperature tier and dressing pack tables (merged into DefaultPricingTemplate). Leave empty to use the global default.
customerForm.standardPricingOverrideFormatHint: Must be a JSON object; saved as compact JSON in the database. Structure matches billing seed standardPricingOverride.
customerForm.standardPricingOverrideStructureHint: Top-level keys are typically highTemperature, lowTemperature, dressingPack (PricingRuleCompiler merge).
customerForm.standardPricingOverrideHybridHint: In hybrid mode, unmatched rows use the standard sterilization path; overrides here are deep-merged into engine tier tables. special_only unmatched rows keep the bill price.
customerForm.standardPricingOverrideInvalid: Standard pricing override must be a valid JSON object
customerForm.pathOverrideDesc: For customers that must deviate from the hospital HT/LT tier table. Often used with “Special rules only” to force how individual job rows are priced.
customerForm.disableLowTempHint: Price low-temp rows on the HT path
customerForm.disableLowTempDesc: When on, low-temp sterilization jobs skip LT tiers and use HT pricing. Example: Daowai People’s Hospital bills all jobs at HT unit price.
customerForm.forceHighTempUnitPriceDesc: Sets a fixed HT unit price (per item), overriding tier breakpoints. Leave empty to keep tier pricing.
customerForm.monthlySettlementDesc: At the job (sterilization batch) level, sum this customer’s monthly sterilization fees first, then apply minimum charge and monthly cap. Each can be configured independently; leave empty or 0 to disable.
customerForm.monthlyMinChargeDesc: Floor: if the monthly sterilization total is below this amount, bill at this amount.
customerForm.monthlyMinChargeHint: Top-up only when total is below the floor
customerForm.monthlyMaxCapDesc: Cap: if the monthly sterilization total exceeds this amount, bill at the cap. Example: Victoria Hospital monthly cap ¥8,000.
customerForm.monthlyMaxCapHint: Cap applies only when total exceeds the limit
customerForm.monthlySettlementHint: Applied to sterilization total after row pricing

customerBillingPolicy.title: Billing policies
customerBillingPolicy.subtitle: Temperature discounts, per-customer logistics rate, monthly min/cap; synced to billing policies for pricing compile
customerBillingPolicy.discountDesc: Configure rate by temperature scope (HT/LT/ANY); optional skip for fixed-price rules
customerBillingPolicy.settlementDesc: Preview settlement letter line items from current policies (export templates in Phase 3)
customerBillingPolicy.settlementExportNote: Settlement export will emit separate lines for adjustments, logistics, etc. Template binding is configured in Phase 3.
customerBillingPolicy.settlementMonthlyHint: Min charge top-up or cap applied after monthly sterilization total
customerBillingPolicy.urgentDesc: Urgent sterilization multiplier and urgent logistics fee
customerBillingPolicy.deductionDesc: Fixed monthly equipment deduction on settlement
customerBillingPolicy.settlementUrgentHint: Independent urgent rows on settlement letter
customerBillingPolicy.logisticsCardDesc: Deduct payable logistics fee from customer logistics card balance
customerBillingPolicy.crossHospitalDesc: Select a logistics_merge group to merge same-day trips and split fee
customerBillingPolicy.splitRatioHint: Empty = equal split; ratios are normalized
customerBillingPolicy.allocationDialogDesc: Configure dept split, cross-hospital merge and ratios in one place. When sync is on, all group members share the same logistics policy fields.
customerBillingPolicy.allocationMembersPlaceholder: Select hospitals sharing the same allocation rule
customerBillingPolicy.allocationMembersMin: Cross-hospital allocation requires at least 2 hospitals
customerBillingPolicy.allocationSyncToMembers: Sync to all group members on save

customerProductRules.title: Special Billing Rules
customerProductRules.productPlaceholder: Search catalog or type pack keyword
customerProductRules.productHint: Type a pack name when the product is not in the catalog; it syncs to match keywords below
customerProductRules.billingModePackNameSuffixHint: Use the last number before "/" in pack name as piece count, e.g. 刮勺探针4 → 4 pieces
customerProductRules.matchConditionsHint: Filter by material, bag size, instrument count; fold/fee rules may use keywords only
customerProductRules.foldThresholdHint: Apply fold ratio above this count
customerProductRules.foldRatioHint: Above threshold, billable count = ceil(instrumentCount / divisor); e.g. 5 means 5 pcs count as 1
customerProductRules.keywordMatchModeHint: Applied to unannotated keywords below; a single keyword can override via suffix, e.g. "needle@contains" or "needle@exact"
customerProductRules.excludeKeywordsHint: Rule is skipped if any exclude keyword matches, e.g. hollow nail
customerProductRules.acceptedPricesHint: Row passes if unit price matches any candidate; at least 2 required
customerProductRules.keywordsHint: Product or scene keywords, comma-separated; a single keyword can override mode via suffix, e.g. "needle@contains" or "needle@exact"
customerProductRules.materialsHint: e.g. non-woven, paper-plastic; all must match
customerProductRules.temperatureHint: HT/LT from row type; ANY matches both
customerProductRules.bagSizeSectionHint: Enable only for paper-plastic bags billed by size. The system detects bag size (e.g. 20cm, 25cm) from package material and pack name. When off, bag size is not checked.
customerProductRules.bagSizeEqualsTooltip: Match only when detected bag size equals this value (cm), e.g. 30 matches 30cm bags only
customerProductRules.bagSizeLessTooltip: Match only when detected bag size is less than this value (cm), e.g. 20 matches 10/15cm small bags
customerProductRules.settlementBehaviorHint: How packaging fee and discount apply when matched
customerProductRules.empty: No special billing rules yet. Click Add Rule to create one.
customerProductRules.conflictItem: "{names}" may match the same rows (same type and conditions)
customerProductRules.inactiveHiddenHint: {count} inactive rule(s) hidden; conflict check applies to active rules only
